an5.193:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.193:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.193:1.3: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu? ko paccayo? yenekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā’pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
an5.193:1.4: ko pana bho gotama hetu? ko paccayo? yenekadā dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatā’pi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā’ti.
an5.193:2.1: yasmiṃ brāhmaṇa, samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, na passati. paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, na passati. ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, na passati. dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā’pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
an5.193:2.2: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa. udapatto saṃsaṭṭho lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā,
an5.193:2.3: tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ nappajāneyya na passeyya,
an5.193:2.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. attatthampi …pe… paratthampi …pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, na passati. dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā’pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
